description: This header file defines the API for a text-based commit graph visualization in a version control system. It includes function declarations for initializing, updating, and displaying a graph, as well as handling line prefixes and colors.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Sets up the global display options for line prefixes in diffs, affecting graph output.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Enables custom coloring for graph columns using ANSI escapes or other schemes.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on revision options.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, preparing it for subsequent line output.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit have been output.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a string buffer, representing part of the commit history visualization.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire commit's graph lines to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints a single line of the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs vertical padding lines in the graph visualization.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints the remaining lines of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints the commit message and remaining graph lines to a specified file.
